学生: a person enrolled in a course of learning
学校: an institution where people receive education
老师: a person whose role is teaching others
朋友: someone joined to another by mutual affection
工作: an activity or role involving regular labor
时间: the measured progression or duration of events
明天: the calendar day following the current one
昨天: the calendar day preceding the current one
这里: a location close to the speaker
那里: a location away from the speaker
家庭: a household or group of related people
儿子: a male child in relation to a parent
女儿: a female child in relation to a parent
孩子: a young person or someone's offspring
早上: the early part of the day
晚上: the later part of the day or night
中午: the middle of the day around noon
去年: the calendar year immediately before this one
明年: the calendar year immediately after this one
天气: the condition of the atmosphere at a place
太阳: the star at the center of our solar system
月亮: Earth's natural satellite seen in the night sky
水果: edible plant produce that is often sweet
苹果: a firm round fruit that grows on trees
香蕉: a long curved tropical fruit with soft flesh
西瓜: a large green-rinded fruit with a juicy interior
米饭: cooked grain commonly served as a staple food
面包: a baked food usually made from flour
牛奶: a dairy liquid produced by cows
咖啡: a drink brewed from roasted beans
电脑: an electronic device that processes information
手机: a handheld device for mobile communication
电视: a medium or device for broadcast moving images
电影: a story or production recorded as moving images
音乐: organized sound created for expression or enjoyment
运动: physical activity performed for exercise or competition
足球: a team sport centered on kicking a ball toward a goal
篮球: a team sport centered on shooting into a raised hoop
颜色: a visual property determined by reflected light
红色: a warm primary color associated with fire
白色: the lightest color, associated with snow
黑色: the darkest color, associated with an absence of light
蓝色: a cool primary color associated with a clear sky
绿色: a color strongly associated with growing plants
医生: a trained professional who provides medical care
医院: a facility where people receive medical treatment
公司: an organization formed to conduct business
商店: a place where goods are offered for sale
饭店: a business serving prepared meals, sometimes with lodging
机场: a place where aircraft take off and land
火车: a connected rail vehicle used for transportation
汽车: a road vehicle powered by an engine
